status: Pre-implementation source and receiving contract; root claim pending
beneficiary: A player who has taken one or more races in the existing browser career and wants to inspect the actual simulated race result after moving to a later turn.
observed_source_problem: App passes the short current-state textLines into RacePanel instead of the current snapshot's retained state.log.
RacePanel requires place/finish tokens which are not emitted by the actual native physics race logger; correcting the prop alone does not admit real physics records.
production_scope: only the RacePanel lines={cs.log} receiving prop in packages/uma-sim-ui/src/App.tsx
new packages/uma-sim-ui/tests/race-results.test.mjs, following existing native test conventions
append the exact new test entry to the existing package.json test script; no dependency change
a concise race-results section in packages/uma-sim-ui/README.md and unique docs/receiving/race-results-afe225d6c6be evidence

native_data_contract.physics_line: Race <race-id> <ordinal> +<fan-gain> fans [physics t=<seconds>s course=<course-id> seed=<seed> field=<field-size> margin_win=<seconds>s margin_ahead=<seconds>s]
native_data_contract.authority: Exact retained engine log strings; full native state and source pins accompany receiving.
visible_facts: Show only fields actually recorded in a recognized line; preserve the literal source record in an expandable detail.
Do not infer placement, finish time or field size from a legacy/stub line, from fans gained, from current settings, or from another race.
Recognized physics facts require valid finite numeric fields and consistent recorded place/field bounds; malformed or unknown records retain their literal text without invented values.
A newer unrecognized Race record must not cause an older result to be relabeled as the newest result.
Keep every retained race occurrence, including repeated race IDs; label the view as retained records rather than promising a complete career archive.
React renders record text literally; markup, odd Unicode and malformed numbers cannot turn into active content or fabricated stats.

interaction_contract: Latest recorded race and retained history remain readable after a later non-race action.
History review and disclosures are read-only and issue no career action requests.
Existing mandatory-race action and busy state stay operational.
Changing the supplied current-career log replaces the displayed records; the component must not retain a prior session's results.
Desktop and narrow-phone views support keyboard access without overflowing; session/request and keyboard routing remain with #63.
receiving: Establish the original RacePanel failure with actual Rust REST-produced physics lines, not invented positive fixtures.
Run at least two real races and a later ordinary action from a disposable seeded career; bind state.log, text output and visible results to the same state.
Use a separate native stub-model career to verify absent result fields stay unknown, not first place or zero seconds.
Native parser/component changed-input controls cover unrelated lines, retained duplicates, malformed fields, unknown newest record and refreshed props.
Actual React typecheck/build and component tests using unchanged declared dependencies.
Fresh Chromium against the real local Rust API and built UI, observing result/history/mandatory control/after-turn behavior with no live account or shared service.
Independent reviewer freezes line, negative and interaction cases before candidate exposure.
Root rechecks complete current repo and central ownership, composes the one App prop with #63/#80, and preserves exact source/CI/receiving boundaries.
exclusions: No engine mechanics, race formulas, RNG, catalogs, settings, logging or storage changes.
No API/session, MCP, policy, checkpoint/library, comparison, Event Log #67/#80, training-demo #83 or Longwater trend changes.
No credentials, live account/session, shared UMA service, restricted Mac or deployed runtime.
No new framework, export route or generated replacement application.
runtime_preconditions: Node v24.19.0 and Playwright1.62.1 are available; existing Chromium path is supplied by root.

Rust compiler and declared React/Vite dependency closure must be located or qualified in an owned isolated environment before native execution; neither is currently on the primary runtime PATH/module root.
Use only bounded owned storage and one-session /dev build temporaries; retain evidence under the owned /dev/shm source area.
